title: ENH: support time-dependent cell parameters for ase.io.vasp write_vasp_xdatcar
body:
The original write_vasp_xdatcar function outputs static cell/lattice
parameters fixed to the first image. This change fixes the format of
output xdatcar and includes label, flag, and cell parameters before
the configuration of each image.
author: cyrusyc

comments.author: cyrusyc
comments.body: Thank you for merging this @yuzie007! This might be a rare situation and not many people need this, but I'm glad to see this tiny fix might be useful.

comments.author: yuzie007
comments.body:
Thank you @cyrusyc for the MR! (although it passes ~3 years)

I have confirmed that the present `write_vasp_xdatcar` is not compatible for images with variant cells.
If such images are given, the function writes a wrong `XDATCAR` with the cell of the first image, without throwing errors.
In this sense, we can say the present MR fixes the bug.

In order to solve the merge conflict as well as to add a test, I have rebased the MR on my side.
I have introduced `_write_xdatcar_header`, which does things similar to VASP `XDAT_HEAD`.

The only thing that may be argued is whether we should offer an option to keep the original in the fixed-cell XDATCAR format.
We can probably leave it in a separate MR, and since we should first make the function safe for variant cells, I would like to proceed for now.

thread.actionability_reasoning: This is a meta-discussion comment summarizing the PR's history, confirming the bug, and describing the contributor's rebase work. While it mentions a potential future option (fixed-cell format), it explicitly defers that to a separate MR and states intent to proceed as-is. No concrete code change is requested in this PR.
